page.layout: One printed page, blank except for a central woodcut device (Pegasus above a caduceus, palm fronds, and a cloud-like base with the letters W and a monogram). No text blocks.
page.notes: The page carries only an engraved printer's device (Pegasus, caduceus, palms, clouds and the letters "W" on either side). No printed words are legible, so nothing is transcribed. The left edge shows darkening and show-through from the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.
